projects.name: ERA Resubmission Automation
points: Built fault-tolerant ETL in **Python/SQL** (Pandas/NumPy) to normalize **X12-835** claims into **PostgreSQL** on **AWS (EC2, S3, RDS)**; wrapped pipelines with validation guardrails and **Dockerized CI/CD**.

Enabled **LangGraph + ChromaDB** services to auto-draft resubmission packets at **10k+/week** while holding latency SLOs; added schema validators, retry/backoff, and observability hooks for safe batch regenerations.
**Result: Removed manual packet prep and shortened reimbursement turnaround, keeping throughput at 10k+/week.**

projects.name: Market Signal Intelligence
points: Designed NLP ingestion on **Python + Spark** into **GCP BigQuery**, generating **HuggingFace** embeddings and unsupervised clusters to surface outbound-sales topics from **~8k posts/month**.
Tuned partitioning, materialized similarity scores, and exposed a low-latency analytics API feeding dashboards with sub-second topic lookups.
**Result: Delivered topic intelligence over ~8k posts/month with sub-second latency, informing outreach prioritization without extra analyst headcount.**

projects.name: Probabilistic Calibration of LLMs
points: Built a simulation-driven evaluation harness in **Python/R** that generates synthetic datasets from controllable **Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)** DGPs (means, covariances, priors, overlap, dimensionality) with exact **Bayes posteriors** for ground truth.
Extended generators to **non-Gaussian** mixtures and manifold datasets (**t-distributions**, **skew-normals**, **two-moons**) to stress-test calibration beyond simple clusters.

Implemented a prompt interaction layer that serializes numeric features and probes **GPT / Claude / Gemini / Perplexity** under **zero-shot/few-shot**, **DGP-disclosed/hidden**, **overconfidence-deterring**, and **JSON-schema-constrained** prompts to isolate prompt effects on probability outputs.

Evaluated outputs with **Brier score**, **ECE**, **calibration curves**, **log loss**, and **QQ-plots**; benchmarked against classical baselines (**EM-GMM posteriors**, **soft k-means**, **random forests**, **gradient boosting**, **neural nets**).
Ran sensitivity analyses over **dimensionality**, **cluster overlap**, **prompt design**, and **few-shot size** to map where LLM probabilities stay calibrated vs. overconfident.
**Result: Produced defensible calibration scorecards showing when LLM probability outputs can be trusted and when classical probabilistic models outperform them.**

projects.name: Hospital Compliance Automation
points: Productionized a **RAG semantic search** service in **Python/FastAPI** using **HuggingFace** encoders and **ChromaDB** on **AWS (EC2, S3)** to answer hospital compliance questionnaires.
Implemented caching, schema validation, and latency tuning across retrieval/inference paths; Dockerized CI/CD for repeatable, low-latency deployments.
Integrated guardrails to enforce hospital-specific constraints and audited responses with monitoring dashboards.
**Result: Reduced compliance questionnaire effort by ~60% while keeping answers aligned with regulatory wording.**

projects.name: Dependency Management and Analysis Platform
points: Built Python crawlers for **static + dynamic dependency extraction** across C/Java/Python services; normalized metadata for multi-language codebases.
Modeled dependency graphs in **MongoDB** and versioned specs in **MySQL** to enable millisecond graph queries and diffing.
Developed an **Angular** UI backed by **Flask** APIs for interactive graph visualization, semantic search, and version-mismatch alerts.
Added build-to-build comparison views and CI/CD alerts on anomalous transitive pulls to pre-empt regressions.
**Result: Improved release cadence and fault isolation by surfacing risky dependency deltas early in the pipeline.**
